name: 05 - Delivery Status Propagation

nodes.name: Supabase Webhook: orders update
nodes.notes: Configure as a Supabase Database Webhook on orders (UPDATE, column: status).

nodes.name: Push Realtime Notification (placeholder)
nodes.notes: As with workflow 3, the customer order page already polls status directly -- placeholder for a push notification channel.

nodes.name: Finalize Payment + Prompt Review (placeholder)
nodes.notes: Phase 3's payment already resolves at checkout time (success/failed), not at delivery time, so 'finalize' here means marking it settled for accounting purposes -- no payments.status transition is defined for this in the current schema. Needs a design decision before implementing for real: either add a payments.status='settled' state or treat 'success' as already final and skip this step. Review-prompt (reviews table) has no write path built yet -- see MEMORY.md's reviews-table stub-policy deferred item.

nodes.name: GET /api/internal/orders/:id/notification-details
nodes.notes: Fetches the delivered email content (customerEmail, emailSubject, deliveredEmailHtml) server-side, since the webhook payload has no email address or order details.

nodes.name: Gmail: Send Order Delivered Email
nodes.notes: Credential intentionally left as a placeholder -- after importing, select your own Gmail OAuth2 credential in this node's Credential dropdown before activating this workflow.

_note: Imported into n8n 2.40.7 and run live on 2026-09-30 (executions 322/323): the delivered branch fetched notification-details and sent the delivered email. Gmail credential is a placeholder -- select your Gmail OAuth2 credential on the Gmail node after importing, save, then Publish. IF filters wrap includes() in String() because n8n 2.40.7 does not coerce a boolean to the string "true".
